_CI_GATE_ENV_KEYS=(
  PATH HOME
  RUNNER_TRACKING_ID
  HTTP_PROXY HTTPS_PROXY SSL_CERT_FILE GH_CONFIG_DIR
  GH_TOKEN REPO PR_NUMBER
  CI_STATUS_CHECK CI_TIMEOUT_SEC CI_CHECKS_FILE
)

wait_for_ci_command() {
  local -a env_args=()
  local key
  for key in "${_CI_GATE_ENV_KEYS[@]}"; do
    if [ -n "${!key+x}" ]; then
      env_args+=("${key}=${!key}")
    fi
  done
  env -i "${env_args[@]}" bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/wait_for_ci.sh"
}

fork_ci_gate() {
  [[ "${CI_STATUS_CHECK:-false}" == "true" ]] || return 0
  CI_GATE_ACTIVE="true"
  wait_for_ci_command >"$CI_GATE_LOG" 2>&1 &
  CI_GATE_PID=$!
}

join_ci_gate() {
  [[ "${CI_GATE_ACTIVE:-false}" == "true" ]] || return 0
  wait "$CI_GATE_PID" || true
  CI_GATE_PID=""
}

cleanup_gate_children() {
  if [[ -n "${CI_GATE_PID:-}" ]]; then
    kill -TERM "$CI_GATE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    CI_GATE_PID=""
  fi
}

_gate_lifecycle_on_exit() {
  local status=$?
  trap - EXIT INT TERM
  cleanup_gate_children
  exit "$status"
}

install_gate_lifecycle_trap() {
  trap '_gate_lifecycle_on_exit' EXIT
  trap '_gate_lifecycle_on_exit' INT
  trap '_gate_lifecycle_on_exit' TERM
}
